# Weather Encyclopedia

## Weather Types

### Clear

| Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|---------|------------||--------|
| Cool | Warm | Cool |
| +25% visibility | Normal | Normal |
| Normal travel | Normal | Normal travel |

### Cloudy

| Effect | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Visibility | -25% |
| Navigation | -2 |
| Ranged | -1 |

### Rain

| Light | Medium | Heavy |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| -1 visibility | -2 visibility | -4 visibility |
| Normal move | -10 ft | -20 ft |
| Fire magic | Fire magic at disadvantage | Fire fails |

### Fog/Mist

| Light | Dense |
|------|--------|
| -1 visibility | -4 visibility |
| Normal move | -10 ft |
| -2 attack | -4 attack |

### Wind

| Speed | Effect |
|------|--------|
| 10 mph | -1 ranged |
| 20 mph | -2 ranged, -10 ft |
| 30 mph | -4 ranged, -20 ft |
| 50+ mph | No ranged, -30 ft |

### Storms

| Type | Damage | Effect |
|------|--------|--------|
| Thunderstorm | Lightning (1d10), fire | Fire magic fail |
| Sandstorm | 1d6 |visibility x0 |
| Blizzard | 1d6 cold | Cold vulnerability |
| Heat Wave | 1d4 heat | +1 level fatigue |

### Extreme Weather

| Weather | Protection |
|----------|------------|
| Lightning | Rubber, shelter |
| Hail | Roof |
| Tornado | Underground |
| Volcano | Distance |

| Temp | Effect |
|------|--------|

### Heat

| Temp | Effect |
|------|--------|
| 100°F | 1 CON/2 hours |
| 110°F | 1 CON/hour |
| 120°F | 1 CON/30 min |

## Weather Generation

| d20 | Weather | Temperature |
|-----|--------|------------|
| 1-2 | Clear | Varies |

| 17 | Snow | Cold |
| 18-19 | Heat | Hot |
| 20 | Special | Varies |
